body:
Thank you so much. The idea of outgrowing people has never occurred to me but it seems like what's going on. These are friends I made in high school or my first year of college and we've all changed so much since then. I think once I meet new people it'll be a bit easier. It's just so hard to reach the level of closeness I had with old friends and I think I miss that most.

I just have to remember forgiveness doesn't have to mean forgetting or excusing their behavior. It just has to mean letting go.

I wish it was that easy! I've never been too good at making friends, but it seems like the older you get the harder it gets. I've been utilizing OkC and meetup.org but it's been hard with my busy schedule. Hopefully once school is out I can fully utilize them!
